name: Hachiya Torakichi
source:
The local supermarket shop owner. He lives in the apartment complex Atsuko and Yui live in with their father. He's a pervert that touches Atsuko's butt the first time he meets her. Yui gets angry at him and demands that he leave her sister alone.
